d:
Presenting the romantic song “Chand Se Parda Keejiye” from the movie Aao Pyaar Karen, beautifully sung by the ever-melodious Kumar Sanu . This soulful track expresses love with poetic elegance, gentle emotions, and a dreamy musical vibe .
Song Details
Title: Chand Se Parda Keejiye
Singer: Kumar Sanu
Music: Aadesh Shrivastav
Cast & Crew
Starring: Saif Ali Khan & Shilpa Shetty
Director: Ravendra Peepat
